checks: Manager completion shows real local words and definitions; clicking fills without translating or recording history
Arrow keys and Tab accept suggestions; Enter accepts an active suggestion and a second Enter explicitly queries
IME composition suppresses suggestions until completion and Escape dismisses the list
Chinese translation with no Microsoft setup gives an honest settings path and makes no request
Chinese to English sends only Chinese input; the editable English translation saves as an English entry with its Chinese meaning
Translation cache reuses repeated Chinese requests while keeping opposite language directions separate
Chinese history is searchable and reopens as Chinese translation; export/import preserves directions and excludes keys
Floating widget has the same completion controls; Escape dismisses suggestions before closing the panel
Widget Chinese translation recognizes an existing English word form and appends the Chinese meaning without overwriting it
Changing direction and word ignores a slower previous Chinese translation
Real Microsoft HTTP errors remain visible and do not break subsequent offline English lookup
